headline: The rise in diesel prices doesn't stop at the gas station. How it ends up costing more, including the shopping basket
summary: Rising oil prices are passing through to diesel at Romanian fuel stations. Because Romania imports much of its petroleum product needs, a more expensive barrel raises costs for transport, agriculture and industry.
why: Romania imports a large share of its refined fuel, so crude price moves quickly affect domestic fuel prices and downstream costs such as transport and food distribution.
